name: trace-research-tools
description: Evidence-first research workflows for Claude Code.

plugins.name: trace-paper-studio
plugins.description: Name a paper or hand over a PDF: Trace finds it on arXiv, grounds every claim in a page and quote, and builds a local interactive site with primers, step-by-step derivations, live equation playgrounds and an evidence-linked quiz. Rewrite one section, quiz question or derivation with the evidence locked, strengthen thin sections, reuse and edit story templates, and publish a shareable link.
